target_binary.note: The deciphered Steam 1.03 image. Its .text is byte-identical to GOG (docs/steam-gog-equivalence.md), so every VA and offset here is the GOG binding restated; the two files are generated from one table and must not drift.

purpose: Headless-harness sites (docs/harness-design.md, New sites and the two amendment lists): engine calls the adapter makes and struct fields the state oracle reads. Complements the VM bindings; the generator reads every <alias>_*_bindings.json.
corpus: kotorxid readable tree K1__k1_win_gog_swkotor.exe (binary_id 8); Dev = src/AspyrBuild/depot/KOTOR/PC_Source/Dev, UN = src/_unattributed
accept_rule: accept requires at least two independent signals, at least one of which is not run v1 (METHOD.md section 1). Functions: sqlite func row on the target binary plus a read of the decompiled body, plus the raw prologue where it settles a convention. Fields: the types.h declaration plus an accessor or consumer disassembled from the raw image whose immediate is the offset. A binding with one signal is accepted at confidence < 0.9 and its site stays optional.
field_shape: kind=field rows carry owner, offset and size. addr is the owning global (g_pAppManager) or 0 when the field is reached through a pointer chain. The generator emits no expected_bytes for them.
